description: Find the real cost of factoring one freight invoice as an annual rate, plus the cash you get now and the reserve released later. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

ach.description: Transfer fee per invoice (ACH or wire) (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for transfer fee per invoice (ach or wire). Unknown is not the same as zero.

advance.description: Advance rate. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for advance rate. Unknown is not the same as zero.

days.description: Days until the broker pays (days). Days from funding until the factor collects the invoice.

feeMode.description: Factoring fee type. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for factoring fee type. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: flat = Flat percent of invoice; tiered = Tiered by days until the broker pays.

flatFee.description: Factoring fee, percent of invoice. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for factoring fee, percent of invoice. Unknown is not the same as zero. Used only when feeMode is flat; ignored otherwise.

invoice.description: Invoice amount (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for invoice amount. Unknown is not the same as zero.

other.description: Other fees charged on this invoice (US dollars). For example, an application, credit-check or minimum-volume fee spread to this invoice.

tiers.description: Fee tiers (from your factoring agreement). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for fee tiers (from your factoring agreement). Unknown is not the same as zero. Used only when feeMode is tiered; ignored otherwise.

fee.description: Fee, percent of invoice. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for fee, percent of invoice. Unknown is not the same as zero.

upToDays.description: Paid within this many days (days). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for paid within this many days. Unknown is not the same as zero.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_freight_factoring_true_cost_calculator

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.
